version_note: Source hashes pin this handoff; pin the implementation/engine baseline and immutable approved runtime ruleset ID before execution. No scenarios have run.
source_precedence: Latest explicit game-owner decisions recorded in repository
Architecture requirements for technical-contract tests only
reference_syntax: source_key#JSON_pointer for JSON sources; source_key# means the whole source document, including Markdown.

defaults.hidden_state: Server-only fixture; publish only audience-authorized projections.
defaults.initial_positions: Explicit test inputs, not an approved initial-deal rule.
defaults.clock: Injected server clock; avoid exact equality unless D08 is resolved.
defaults.unknown_expectations: Do not guess, auto-approve, or count blocked entries as passed.

scenarios.title: Exact supported role configurations
given: Use each role map in mode_fixtures; Original Powers disabled.
scenarios.when: Create one match in each supported mode; request a six-player match.
expected: Exactly one unique seat per listed role; faction and total counts match the selected mode.
Officer exists only in mode 9; Red Disabler only in modes 8 and 9.
Six-player creation is not an available current configuration.

scenarios.title: Code structure and order independence
given: Each supported mode has assigned unique player numbers.
scenarios.when: Generate Code facts; validate an exact reordered copy and a set with one wrong member.
expected: Exactly four distinct numbers, including Alien and excluding Undercover.
The reordered exact set is correct; the wrong set is incorrect.
Do not infer a terminal victory checkpoint from validation alone.
scenarios.limits: No uniform-selection distribution is assumed by this specification.

scenarios.title: Direct ordinary shooting without identification
given: R4 or R5; healthy free shooter; legal unused ordinary weapon; same-location target; no immunity, defense, or movement.
Run for eligible Blue, Red and Alien shooters; include Officer in mode 9.
scenarios.when: Register and resolve a direct shot carrying only its target.
expected: No third-player or faction-identification field is required.
A healthy target becomes Injured; an injured target becomes Eliminated.
No wrong-identification failure branch runs.

scenarios.title: Ordinary and Officer round windows
given: Healthy free shooter in their own ordinary turn with a same-location target and unused legal weapon.
scenarios.when: Attempt ordinary shots in R1/R3/R4/R5; repeat with Officer in mode 9.
expected: Ordinary weapons are unavailable in R1/R3 and available in R4/R5.
Officer may use the starting shot from R1.
scenarios.limits: Unrelated location and defense conditions remain fixed and legal.

scenarios.title: Officer lifetime ordinary-shot cap
given: Mode 9 Officer has resolved the one ordinary shot.
Separately model the circumstance that Supplier makes another weapon available.
scenarios.when: Attempt another ordinary shot during an otherwise legal own turn.
expected: No second ordinary shot can be accepted/resolved during the match.
Supplier cannot bypass the Officer cap.
The separate showdown-shot exception is covered by BAL-020.
scenarios.limits: This does not decide whether Supplier may select Officer as a recipient or how an unusable grant is represented.

scenarios.title: Ordinary shooting eligibility and Command immunity
given: Single ordinary shot; no optional powers.
scenarios.when: Try to register while Injured, Jailed, or Eliminated; separately target a player currently in Command Room.
expected: An ineligible shooter cannot register an ordinary shot.
A player inside Command Room cannot be targeted by ordinary shots.
No rejected request causes damage.

scenarios.title: Actor status does not discard valid registration
given: An action was valid when registered.
scenarios.when: Before its scheduled stage change the actor to Injured, Jailed, or Eliminated.
expected: Do not remove or cancel the action solely because of the actor status change.
Resolve at its scheduled stage subject to applicable target defenses and confirmed conditions.
scenarios.limits: The final hit outcome with relocation is blocked by D04; this case asserts queue retention, not invented location semantics.

scenarios.title: Voluntary movement quota and phase
given: Healthy free player in A/B with one remaining movement this round.
scenarios.when: Move once before voting, then request a second move; request movement after voting starts; separately request voluntary departure from Hospital/Jail.
expected: One A/B move is allowed before voting; a second in the same round is rejected.
Voluntary movement is unavailable after voting starts.
Hospital/Jail do not allow voluntary departure.

scenarios.title: Captain title after leaving Command
given: Healthy free Captain in Command with an available movement; use an approved fixture destination.
scenarios.when: Leave Command; request return during the same round.
expected: Leaving alone preserves Captain status.
Command immunity is absent outside the room.
The same-round return is unavailable because movement is spent.
scenarios.limits: A/B adjacency and later return route require D02; this case does not choose a route.

scenarios.title: Self-Protection and delayed activation
given: Undercover has never received Protection; legal self-grant in R3.
scenarios.when: Grant Protection to self and advance to the next normal round.
expected: Self-targeting is valid.
The new instance does not block an attack in the grant round.
It becomes active at the start of R4.
scenarios.limits: Who learns the grant is separate from internal engine state and remains D09.

scenarios.title: Protection lifetime receipt limit
given: A player has already received one Protection, whether pending, active, or consumed.
scenarios.when: Request a second grant to that same player.
expected: No second Protection is granted in any of those states.
Self-targeting does not bypass the lifetime limit.

scenarios.title: Active Protection blocks once
given: Healthy stationary target has active Protection at R4 start; one legal ordinary attack in R4 and a separate one in R5.
No other effects apply.
scenarios.when: Resolve the attacks in their separate rounds.
expected: R4 attack deals no damage; Protection and attack resource are consumed.
R5 attack is not blocked by the consumed instance and makes the healthy target Injured.
scenarios.limits: Separate rounds avoid assuming an unresolved order among competing normal-stage attacks.

scenarios.title: Jail vote threshold and Protection bypass
given: All 7/8/9 players are eligible voters at voting start; protected target; no optional powers.
scenarios.when: Apply unique-top votes of 4/4/5 respectively; also test one less and an 8-player 4–4 tie.
expected: The unique target meets the threshold at 4/7, 4/8 or 5/9 and is Jailed without damage.
One vote below those counts is insufficient; 4–4 tie jails nobody.
Protection is neither a veto nor consumed by the vote.
The denominator is eligible voters, not ballots cast.

scenarios.title: Cracker self-rescue and irreversible elimination
given: Injured, non-jailed Cracker has an unused rescue.
Separate case: a validly registered rescue target becomes Eliminated during the preceding damage stage.
scenarios.when: Resolve Rescue.
expected: Injured Cracker may self-rescue without an optional power and becomes Healthy.
Rescue cannot revive an Eliminated target.
A heal never removes Jail.
scenarios.limits: Hospital exit and cross-room access are blocked separately; this case does not relocate the healed player.

scenarios.title: Hacker Scan use and information
given: Healthy free Hacker; same-location legal target, no Command immunity.
scenarios.when: Submit an incorrect faction guess; retry a scan in that round; compare with a correct-guess fixture.
expected: Incorrect guess reveals no Code information and consumes that round scan.
No second scan is available that round.
Correct guess returns only membership in the unordered Code, not a position.

scenarios.title: One Code attempt in Round 5
given: Hacker is non-eliminated; vary Healthy, Injured, and Jailed states.
scenarios.when: Submit during R5, then attempt again; separately try before R5, as a non-Hacker, and after Hacker elimination.
expected: One attempt is allowed during R5 despite Injury/Jail.
A second attempt is unavailable even after an incorrect Code.
Other roles and eliminated Hacker cannot submit; ability is not inherited.
No submission is accepted in R4.
scenarios.limits: Use times clearly inside each phase, not exact boundary races. Terminal result timing remains D06.

scenarios.title: Ordinary turn and additional Hack time
given: Eligible player requests Hack well within the ordinary minute; cap and target conditions satisfied.
scenarios.when: Advance the controlled clock through the ordinary turn and the conversation.
expected: Ordinary turn lasts 60 seconds shared by speaking/action.
Hack conversation starts after it and lasts another 60 seconds.
The next ordinary player turn follows that conversation.
A request made clearly after the ordinary minute cannot start its Hack.
scenarios.limits: Exact equality and network/commit race behavior require D08; use well-separated timestamps here.

scenarios.title: Hack caps and disclosure rule
given: Eligible same-location participants; no optional powers.
scenarios.when: Attempt a second personal initiation and a third conversation in one round; inspect the R5 player instructions.
expected: Each player initiates at most once per match; a round contains at most two conversations.
R5 instructions retain the content embargo through game end.
No ordinary private messaging channel is added.
scenarios.limits: Human truthfulness and spoken embargo compliance cannot be proved by automated tests.

scenarios.title: Conditional showdown trigger
given: Normal R5 effects and the normal victory check have completed.
scenarios.when: Compare a fixture with a determined winner to one where none applies.
expected: A determined winner ends the match without showdown.
No winner triggers one final showdown, not R6 or indefinite rounds.

scenarios.title: Showdown participants and independent ammunition
given: No winner after R5; include healthy, injured, jailed, eliminated players, and a spent Officer in mode 9.
scenarios.when: Enter showdown.
expected: Every non-eliminated participant transfers to Final Zone, including Injured/Jailed.
Each receives one special one-damage shot regardless of prior ordinary weapons.
Eliminated players receive none.
Forced placement does not spend voluntary movement.
A spent Officer receives this separate shot.

scenarios.title: Showdown order and eliminated shooter
given: Targets are all secretly registered before resolution.
In R5 order: A targets injured B; B targets healthy C; C targets healthy A. No defenses apply.
scenarios.when: Resolve A, then B, then C.
expected: A eliminates B.
B still deals one damage to C despite B elimination.
C deals one damage to A.
The sequence follows R5 order, independent of registration arrival.
scenarios.limits: This constructed sequence never targets a player already eliminated by an earlier shot.

scenarios.title: Showdown Protection and loss of room immunity
given: Captain was in Command and is forced to Final Zone; active Protection present in one fixture and absent in another.
scenarios.when: Resolve the first legal special shot at Captain.
expected: Being Captain gives no Command Room immunity in Final Zone.
Existing active Protection blocks and is consumed in the protected fixture.
Without it the special shot deals one damage.
scenarios.limits: No optional-power interaction or newly granted R5 Protection activation is introduced.

scenarios.title: Showdown terminal checkpoint
given: All registered special shots have resolved.
Use separate snapshots: clearly satisfied Blue elimination victory; clearly satisfied Red elimination victory; no existing winner.
scenarios.when: Evaluate the final result.
expected: Apply the existing faction victory rules only after all special shots finish.
If none applies the terminal result is Draw.
Do not start another showdown or normal round.
scenarios.limits: Alien solo fixtures additionally need evidence for the baseline simultaneous-elimination condition; do not infer simultaneity from survivor counts alone.

scenarios.title: Hidden actions do not leak through the table
given: Authoritative state contains roles, Code, weapons, Protection and hidden registered targets.
scenarios.when: Register a private action; inspect public documents/events and rendered table data.
expected: Public views do not expose role, Code, weapons, Protection or private target queues before authorized disclosure.
No unrelated public sequence/timestamp changes reveal a secret registration.
Elimination faction reveal respects its public-phase timing; exact role/power waits until game end.
scenarios.limits: Architecture supplies side-channel constraints; positive private-recipient visibility is pending D09.

scenarios.title: Retry, replay and reconnect integrity
given: Pinned engine/ruleset; recorded deterministic random facts; approved command IDs and view contracts.
scenarios.when: Replay a fixture; resend the same accepted command; reconnect the same seat; deliver an obsolete phase task.
expected: Replay produces the same authoritative result.
One command causes one effect and at most one resource spend.
Reconnect preserves role, resources and seat.
An obsolete phase task does not advance the current phase.
scenarios.limits: These are architecture requirements, not additional game rules. Backend owns transaction and scheduler integration tests.
